items.evidence: Page field evidence maps repository.githubId/fullName/name/stars/forks/language/pushedAt/license/state to F1-F6 and editorial.summary/audience/features/stack to F7-F13; the research Snapshot repeats the same GitHub facts and the verified repository facts reference those fact IDs directly.

The research note separates facts from inference: editorial.hook/meaning/opportunity are marked inferred in the Page field evidence table, while the underlying claims point back to F7-F11 and the direction rationale sections explain the derived classroom/demo/support/creator/family uses.
程序已逐项核对 githubId、fullName、许可证、仓库状态、fetchedAt、Star、Fork 与 pushedAt；项目值与本轮 GitHub 原始快照完全一致，计数保持整数且未转成实时描述。
F6 states GitHub metadata and the official COPYING file both resolve to GPL-2.0 / GNU General Public License v2.0; no conflicting license source text appears in the note or project JSON.
Hook '把屏幕、摄像头和多路声音录成讲解视频' is natural Chinese with a clear 把…录成… structure and concrete nouns from F7-F11; it does not rely on coined abstractions or English syntax.

summary names the input surfaces (screen/area/window on Windows and Linux), core actions (multi-source audio, webcam overlay, countdown/timer, magnifier/Showclick/Halo), and the visible result (录屏视频).

summary plus features cover at least three core capabilities: recording screen/region/window, mixing multiple audio sources, built-in camera overlay, and auxiliary tools like countdown/timer/magnifier/Showclick/Halo.

editorial.stack keeps C++/Qt6/GStreamer/PulseAudio/Wayland/pipewire/xdg-desktop-portal, and F13 ties those terms to the Linux build/runtime environment, so the technical level supports reuse understanding instead of gratuitous jargon.
hook is a short memory phrase only; summary expands the product into a full picture with platforms, capture targets, audio, camera overlay, and helper tools without repeating the hook verbatim.
meaning only explains reuse value ('方便继续做课堂、演示、排障和讲解类产品') and does not introduce a new product; the concrete direction ideas are kept separate in opportunity and directions.
opportunity links verified abilities to specific futures: classroom video from课件+麦克风+摄像头, demo clips from窗口录制+放大镜+Showclick/Halo, support repro from多路音频+倒计时+定时器, and creator素材 from屏幕+摄像头+多路声音.

editorial.audience is the original-user group ('需要在 Windows 或 Linux 上录课、做演示或讲解的人'); each direction audience is a new target group, and each scope is a 3–6 item minimal tool set that supports its own workflow.

Each selected direction names a concrete recurring user/problem in its rationale: teachers/trainers needing lecture replay, demo staff needing readable customer demos, and support staff needing reproduction handoff.

Each selected direction states input → process → result: lesson window + mic/camera → record with countdown → replayable lecture video; app window + click cues → record with highlights → demo short; fault scene + audio → timer-controlled capture → repro video.

All three selected directions cite reused capabilities from F8-F11 and compare against the original generic recording flow; each has at least four changed axes (audience, input, workflow, outcome) in its direction rationale.
Selected scopes are closed and minimal: classroom (5 items), demo (5 items), support repro (5 items). None include roadmap items or decorative extras beyond what the described workflow needs.

All ten unique pairs show at least two substantive differences in the pairwise audit, and the selected trio (classroom/demo/support) are separated by audience plus workflow/outcome, not just file type or UI styling.
Each direction states a concrete benefit: clearer lecture replay for teachers, readable customer demos for sales/demo roles, and a handoffable repro package for support.
The selected set is entirely non-commercial/learning-support oriented, so the required non-commercial value is preserved without needing a theme exception.
